subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.

Emotional stimulation provides the necessary __________ for creative imagination. (fecundity)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fecundity"** means **the ability to produce an abundance of offspring or new growth; fertility.** (उर्वरता)

 
 
• **Example:** The **fecundity **of the soil in this region allows for a bountiful harvest every year.
 
 
 
• **"Fertility"** refers to the quality of being fertile; productiveness. (उर्वरता)
 
 
• **Example:** The **fertility** of the land made it an ideal place for farming.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Force** (शक्ति): Strength or energy as an attribute of physical action or movement.

 
 
• **Example:** The** force** of the wind knocked down several trees.
 
 
 
• **Fulcrum** (टेक): The point on which a lever rests or is supported and on which it pivots.
 
 
• **Example:** The **fulcrum** of the seesaw allowed it to move up and down effortlessly.
 
 
 
• **Freedom** (स्वतंत्रता): The power or right to act, speak, or think as one wants without hindrance or restraint.
 
 
• **Example:** **Freedom** of speech is a fundamental right in many democracies.
 
 

3d:Tc68,

The correct answer is Option 2
